text: one more from “chronicles of wasted time”

quotedTweet.text: “The saddest thing to me, in looking back on my life, has been to recall, not so much the wickedness I have been involved in, the cruel and selfish and egotistic things I have done, the hurt I have inflicted on those I loved—although that’s all painful enough. What hurts most is the preference I have so often shown for what is inferior, tenth-rate, when the first-rate was there for the having.” - from Malcolm Muggeridge’s “Chronicles of Wasted Time”
